page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.2xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on the arm64 architecture, running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server includes 474 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. It operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The arm64 architecture and dedicated physical cores offer a distinct resource density profile, balancing compute power with local NVMe storage. The lack of simultaneous multithreading ensures predictable execution times for compute tasks, though it limits parallel thread scaling compared to hyperthreaded architectures. The integrated local NVMe SSD storage reduces the need for external network-attached storage for scratch space, optimizing qualitative cost efficiency for data-intensive operations.

This instance configuration is designed for workloads requiring dedicated compute resources and fast local storage, such as distributed data processing, batch processing, application servers, and localized database hosting.
